title: Ticket

handling_type.description: Registered value; built-in values: web_attack, scan, cloud, other. Plugins may register more values; the core registry validates them.

specialist.description: Registered value; built-in values: none, web, cloud. Plugins may register more values; the core registry validates them.

awaiting_human_at.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when the ticket entered awaiting_human; null before entry. Preserve this timestamp after leaving awaiting_human. The current state machine has no re-entry path. Recording on entry and retaining on exit are box 10 responsibilities (K12); do not substitute created_at or updated_at.
